description: This file contains helper functions for speech comparison, including text normalization, comparison logic, and HTML tag stripping, used in a speaking modal component.

methods.name: normalizeText
methods.description: Converts text to lowercase, removes punctuation, trims, splits into words, and filters out empty strings.

methods.name: compareTexts
methods.description: Compares two texts and returns a comparison result with alignment and correctness status.

methods.name: toMissing
methods.description: Creates a ComparisonWord of type Missing for a given word.

methods.name: toExtra
methods.description: Creates a ComparisonWord of type Extra for a given word.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Searches for a needle in a haystack and returns comparisons and updated haystack.

methods.name: matchTexts
methods.description: Aligns and compares original and utterance words, identifying insertions, omissions, and matches.

methods.name: alignWords
methods.description: Aligns words from original and utterance, handling insertions and omissions.

methods.name: stripHtmlTags
methods.description: Removes HTML tags from a string.
